_note: Computed from RECORDED costs, no model was queried. The budget is the cascade's realized per-problem spend under tau, matched problem by problem rather than on the mean: matching on the mean would hand every problem the same money and hide that the expensive problems are exactly the degenerate ones. A tier whose matched budget buys fewer than min_vote samples is always-frontier or always-cheapest relabelled, not self-consistency.
